dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam! How was your job interview?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm! ˈhaʊ wʌz jʊr ˈdʒɑːb ˈɪntərvjuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not bad, I think. There were three interviewers, and they asked me a lot of questions.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈbæd, aɪ ˈθɪŋk. ðɛr wɜːr ˈθriː ˈɪntərvjuːərz, ənd ðeɪ ˈæskt miː ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈkwɛstʃənz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: First, they asked me why I wanted the position. Then they asked what I knew about the company.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɜːrst, ðeɪ ˈæskt miː ˈwaɪ aɪ ˈwɑːntɪd ðə pəˈzɪʃən. ˈðɛn ðeɪ ˈæskt ˈwʌt aɪ ˈnuː əˈbaʊt ðə ˈkʌmpəni.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Did you know much about it?
dialogue.reading: dɪd juː ˈnoʊ ˈmʌtʃ əˈbaʊt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I read the job description three times before the interview!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪ ˈrɛd ðə ˈdʒɑːb dɪˌskrɪpʃən ˈθriː ˈtaɪmz bɪˈfɔːr ði ˈɪntərvjuː!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Smart! What else did they ask?
dialogue.reading: ˈsmɑːrt! ˈwʌt ˈɛls dɪd ðeɪ ˈæsk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: One interviewer asked me what I wanted to do in five years. That was a hard question!
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌn ˈɪntərvjuːər ˈæskt miː ˈwʌt aɪ ˈwɑːntɪd tə ˈduː ɪn ˈfaɪv ˈjɪrz. ðæt wʌz ə ˈhɑːrd ˈkwɛstʃən!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I asked them that, too. They said there were twenty candidates for one vacancy.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈæskt ðɛm ˈðæt, ˈtuː. ðeɪ ˈsɛd ðɛr wɜːr ˈtwɛnti ˈkændɪdəts fər ˈwʌn ˈveɪkənsi.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Twenty? Wow. Well, I hope you get it. Fingers crossed!
dialogue.reading: ˈtwɛnti? ˈwaʊ. ˈwɛl, aɪ ˈhoʊp juː ˈɡɛt ɪt. ˈfɪŋɡərz ˈkrɔːst!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! They asked me when I could start, so I hope that's good news.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! ðeɪ ˈæskt miː ˈwɛn aɪ kʊd ˈstɑːrt, soʊ aɪ ˈhoʊp ðæts ˈɡʊd ˈnuːz.
